svg.title: The resolver, from two exports to companies and a review queue
svg.desc: The resolver loads both exports as Record nodes, normalizes names into Entity keys, weights tokens by IDF with bigram SIMILAR links for typos, then blocks and scores CANDIDATE pairs using domain and city. Pairs above the merge score become SAME_AS and are grouped by label propagation into 211 companies. Doubtful pairs become POSSIBLE_MATCH, leaving 7 pairs for a human to review.
